name: loop-basic
what: A loop to the end: all items done; the check-in re-plan ends the loop rather than inventing a to-do.
prompt:
Plan this work for the package in this folder, then present the plan with PresentPlan:

Add src/strings.js exporting two functions:
- slugify(text): lowercase; runs of spaces and punctuation become a single hyphen; no leading or trailing hyphens.
- truncate(text, max): returns text unchanged when it fits; otherwise cuts it to max characters including a trailing "…".

Each function gets tests with node:test under test/. Add a short "Usage" section to README.md showing both.

Give each to-do a check command that proves it is done (for example a focused `node --test test/<file>` run), and use todo_details for checks and for any to-do that must wait for another.

expectations.pattern: no further action|nothing (left|further|more) to do|no action needed|no additional work
expectations.known: round2-modes-policies.md: with nothing left the model presented todos: [] (rejected by planFile.ts) and then a do-nothing to-do that the loop ran.
